svg.title: Ag2Te particle morphology interpretation
svg.desc: Original MatterSyn schematic based on Li et al. 2001 Figure 2A TEM and XRD Figure 1. Approximately spherical particles of source-reported about 20 nm diameter appear in projected agglomerates. This is not an atomistic reconstruction or a measured image.

g.text: About 20 nm spherical particles; projected aggregates in TEM
Monoclinic Ag2Te: a=8.18 Å, b=8.94 Å, c=8.07 Å, β=112.8°
Author-drawn particle interpretation from source Figure 2; particle count and aggregate geometry are not measured.
